title: Studio in the centre · Metro 2 min
description: Small but bright studio, five minutes from the station, with a real bed, a kitchenette for simple meals, and fast WiFi for remote work. Self check-in at any hour, blackout curtains, and a quiet courtyard side so you sleep well even in the centre.

title: Family flat near the park
description: Spacious family flat with two bedrooms, a 180 cm king bed, a fully equipped kitchen, washer, workspace and fibre WiFi. Walk-in shower, luggage drop-off, and a host answering in under an hour. Ideal base for families visiting the city for a week or more, with the park two minutes on foot and bakeries on the same street.
